newsitem.title: USA: Group buys 36,000 Enertec Resource shrs.
newsitem.headline: Group buys 36,000 Enertec Resource shrs.

text.p: A group of affiliated investment partnerships said Friday it had acquired 36,000 common shares of Enertec Resource Services Inc at US$6.44 per share.

The purchases were made for investment purposes, said the group, which is comprised of Centennial Energy Partners LP, Tercentennial Energy Partners LP, Quadrennial Partners LP and Joseph H. Reich and Co Inc.

Joseph Reich, Peter Seldin, Bryan Dutt and Tracy Nagler are general partners of Centennial Energy, Tercentennial Energy and Quadrennial Energy and are executive officers of Joseph H. Reich and Co Inc.
